description: Address code review findings: XSS escaping, transactional imports, backup API, restore with db reopen, student profile level-scoped progress, and IPC input validation.
steps: Apply escapeHtml in all renderer screens where user data is interpolated
Include escape-html.js script in index.html before screen scripts
Wrap replace-mode import operations in db.transaction() in src/services/import.js
Change backup service to use db.backup() API instead of fs.copyFileSync
Fix restore IPC handler to close db, copy file, then reopen
Fix student profile progress calculation to use level surah count
Add basic IPC input validation for critical handlers in main.js
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes after all changes
Replace-mode imports are atomic (wrapped in transaction)
Restore closes and reopens the db connection
Student profile uses correct total surah count based on level
Critical IPC handlers validate input and return error objects for invalid input
